tool.name: PlasBench score
tool.description: predicted plasmids against a labelled complete reference

param.name: truth
param.label: Reference truth labels
param.help: TSV produced by the PlasBench truth step: one row per reference sequence, labelled plasmid or chromosome. Ground truth must come from the reference, never from a tool being scored.

param.name: paf
param.label: Prediction-to-reference alignment (PAF)
param.help: Output of the PlasBench align tool, or any minimap2 PAF of the predicted-plasmid FASTA against the same reference.

param.name: prediction
param.label: Predicted-plasmid FASTA
param.help: The sequence one tool considers plasmid, as a single FASTA.

param.name: ambiguity_paf
param.label: All-mappings PAF (optional)
param.help: A second PAF retaining secondary alignments. Used only to report repeated sequence that maps to both plasmid and chromosome; it never changes F1.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore only.

param.name: tool_name
param.label: Tool identifier
param.help: Which reconstruction tool produced this prediction, e.g. mob_recon.

validator.message: Use letters, digits, dot, dash or underscore only.

param.label: Plasmid recovery threshold
param.help: Fraction of a truth plasmid that must be recovered for it to count as recovered.

tool.help:
**What it does**
Scores one predicted-plasmid FASTA against a complete reference whose sequences are already labelled plasmid or chromosome.
Every predicted base is projected onto the reference through the PAF alignment, giving a base-level confusion matrix with the plasmid class as positive: true positives are true plasmid bases claimed, false positives are chromosomal bases wrongly claimed, false negatives are plasmid bases missed. Overlapping alignments are merged so no base is counted twice. Predicted sequence that does not align at all is reported separately rather than punished as contamination, since it cannot be attributed to either origin.
Because every tool is reduced to the same representation — one FASTA of what it calls plasmid — classifiers and re-assemblers become directly comparable.
**Inputs**
Truth labels and a PAF of the prediction against the *same* reference. Produce the PAF with the **PlasBench align** tool so the alignment filters match.
**Output**
One tabular row per sample and tool: TP/FP/FN bases, precision, recall, F1, plasmid-level recovery and alignment diagnostics. Concatenate rows from several runs and feed them to **PlasBench aggregate** for a leaderboard.
